name: 多子图组合（Figure 1A-F）

prompt_template.subject: {figure_topic}
prompt_template.layout: grid of 2-6 labeled sub-panels (A, B, C, D) with shared title
prompt_template.style: cohesive multi-panel figure with consistent styling across panels
prompt_template.color_scheme: unified palette across all panels, consistent accent color
prompt_template.labels: panel labels A/B/C/D in bold uppercase at top-left of each panel, shared scale bars

overrides.layout: asymmetric layout with one large hero panel and smaller supporting panels
left-to-right horizontal flow of panels showing progressive stages
vertical stack of panels sharing a common x-axis

category_tips.biology: A: 实验流程图, B: 代表性图像(WB/IF), C: 统计图, D: 机制图；共享 n 值和统计标记
category_tips.medicine: A: 临床流程(CONSORT), B: 患者基线表, C: 主要终点 Kaplan-Meier, D: 安全性
category_tips.chemistry: A: 合成路线, B: NMR 谱图, C: MS 谱图, D: 晶体结构；共享化合物编号
category_tips.physics: A: 实验装置, B: 原始数据, C: 拟合曲线, D: 残差分析；共享单位
category_tips.engineering: A: 系统架构, B: 原型照片, C: 性能曲线, D: 对比表；共享指标
category_tips.math: A: 问题定义, B: 几何示意, C: 迭代收敛, D: 误差分析；共享公式编号

examples: Multi-panel scientific figure, 2x2 grid. Panel A (top-left): experimental workflow flowchart. Panel B (top-right): representative Western blot image placeholder with molecular weight markers. Panel C (bottom-left): bar chart of quantification with error bars and significance markers */**. Panel D (bottom-right): mechanism diagram showing drug target interaction. Panel labels A/B/C/D in bold uppercase at top-left of each panel. Unified palette blue #2563eb and gray #6b7280 across all panels. Shared scale bar. 4K, publication-ready.

Multi-panel figure for physics experiment, asymmetric layout. Large hero panel A (left): experimental apparatus diagram with labeled components. Smaller panels: B (top-right): raw signal vs time, C (middle-right): FFT spectrum, D (bottom-right): fitted curve with residuals. Panel labels A-D bold. Shared x-axis label (Frequency, Hz). 4K.

Multi-panel chemistry figure, left-to-right horizontal flow. Panel A: synthesis route with reagents and conditions on arrows. Panel B: 1H NMR spectrum with peak assignments. Panel C: 13C NMR spectrum. Panel D: HRMS spectrum. Panel E: ORTEP crystal structure drawing. Panel labels A-E bold uppercase. Unified grayscale with blue accent. 4K, journal style.
accuracy_tips: 子图标签 A/B/C/D 加粗置于左上角；子图间风格统一（字体/线宽/配色）；共享坐标轴和比例尺；不虚构实验数据图像；统计标记一致（*/**/***对应 p<0.05/0.01/0.001）；分子量标记/单位一致；化合物编号跨子图一致。
